name: video-player-fix
description: Fix X/Twitter video-slider drag drift in Firefox, with hold-to-2x playback as an extra convenience.
author: Ryan Bucshon

scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && web-ext lint --source-dir dist --warnings-as-errors
scripts.package: npm run check && web-ext build --source-dir dist --artifacts-dir artifacts --overwrite-dest
scripts.start: npm run build && web-ext run --source-dir dist --start-url https://x.com
